title: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Subarrays With Sum Equals Target
summary: Given an array of numbers and a target sum, find the greatest count of non-overlapping subarrays where each subarray sums to the target.
statement: Given an array of numbers and a target sum, find the greatest count of non-overlapping subarrays where each subarray sums to the target.
constraints: Choose the greatest number of pairwise non-overlapping contiguous subarrays, each summing to target.
Values may be negative, zero, or positive.
hints: Track prefix sums since the end of the last selected interval.
When prefix-target was seen, a target-sum subarray ends here.
Greedily select it immediately, increment the answer, and reset the segment prefix set.
Earliest finishing intervals maximize the count by the standard interval-scheduling exchange argument.
editorial: Earliest finishing intervals maximize the count by the standard interval-scheduling exchange argument.

tests.explanation: The first two and next two values form two non-overlapping target-sum subarrays.
Three disjoint target-sum intervals can be selected.
